name: Power Amplifier - Re-ATK
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Re-ATK capability.

ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
